entities.name: Francis Emmanuel Ogbonna Okobo

entities.summary: Francis Emmanuel Ogbonna Okobo was a Nigerian Catholic prelate who served as the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Nsukka from 19 November 1990 to 13 April 2013.
